command:
\
set -e; \
echo "TEST-03-RESULT: gitignore-has-4-rules check-ignore=0 ls-files-untracked=1 no-env-in-diff env-still-tracked"; \
grep -qE "^\.env$" .gitignore && grep -qE "^\.env\.\*" .gitignore && grep -qE "^!\.env\.example" .gitignore && grep -qE "^\.claude/settings\.local\.json" .gitignore && echo "rule-env-ok"; \
git check-ignore .claude/settings.local.json >/dev/null && echo "check-ignore=0"; \
if git ls-files --error-unmatch .claude/settings.local.json >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "ls-files=0 UNEXPECTED"; exit 1; else echo "ls-files-untracked=1"; fi; \
if git diff 0cf382f..16292dd --name-only | grep -iE "\.env|credential|secret|settings\.local"; then echo "env-in-diff UNEXPECTED"; exit 1; else echo "no-env-in-diff"; fi; \
git ls-files | grep -E "^\.env$" >/dev/null && git ls-files | grep -E "^\.env\.production$" >/dev/null && echo "env-still-tracked"; \
echo "TEST-03 ALL-CHECKS-PASS"
